fields.name: goal_target
fields.description: The [y, x] position, as it stands at the start of execution, of the target that the goal instruction's ordinal picks out. Written at step #1 (the only step that shows the demonstration) and copied unchanged at every later step; unknown only if no demonstration is shown. How to fill it: (1) walk the demonstration in time order and list every release of the goal-named cube onto a target: a frame where the fingers open from ~46% to ~100% right after frames where that cube was 'held in the gripper', and the cube then rests within a few pixels of one of the listed targets. Ignore the cube's starting spot, button presses (fingers 0% open, nothing held) and the final release near the image centre at about [82, 127] where no target lies. The ordinal ('first' = 1, 'second' = 2, 'third' = 3, 'fourth' = 4) selects one of these releases; note the target the cube rested on, by its position at the moment of that release. (2) Track that target through the END-OF-DEMO SHUFFLE: after the final centre release, while the gripper is parked at about [54, 128] at height 0.2, two of the four targets may slide across the table and trade places over the last few demo frames (intermediate positions appear for two or three frames, then the same set of four positions as before reappears). If the noted target is one of the two that moved, its final position is the ORIGINAL position of the other moving target; if it did not move, or no target moved, its position is unchanged. Record that final position, read from the last demo frame or the scene at the start of execution. e.g. [101, 166]
